_notes: Grom's Rest boss + rare loot (2026-10-22). ONE item drops per kill from the pool. item_level = creature level + 3; real loot formulas (tools/build_durotar_content.make).

Satyr Warlord.name: Warlord's Hewing Cleaver
Satyr Warlord.flavor_text: A two-handed satyr axe, notched by every war it never lost.

Satyr Warlord.name: Horn-Plated Spaulders
Satyr Warlord.flavor_text: Mail pauldrons with a ram's horn riveted to each. They are heavier than they look and louder than they should be.

Satyr Warlord.name: Cloven-Hide Belt
Satyr Warlord.flavor_text: Leather cut from something with split hooves. It pulls tight and never quite lets go.

Satyr Warlord.name: Signet of the Ritual Hall
Satyr Warlord.flavor_text: A ring of blackened horn. It is warm in the way a hand is warm, and nobody is attached to it.

Void Handmaiden.name: Handmaiden's Veilwand
Void Handmaiden.flavor_text: A wand of pale wood that does not quite reflect light. Point it at a thing and the thing is a little less there.

Void Handmaiden.name: Veilweave Robes
Void Handmaiden.flavor_text: Cloth that hangs as if the wearer were underwater. They stopped noticing years ago.

Void Handmaiden.name: Gloves of Quiet Hunger
Void Handmaiden.flavor_text: Thin gloves, very patient. They finish sentences you have not said yet.

Void Handmaiden.name: Siphon Pendant
Void Handmaiden.flavor_text: A bead of violet glass. Hold it to the light and the light holds back.

Doomguard Sentinel.name: Doomplate Greaves
Doomguard Sentinel.flavor_text: Plate that has stood in the fire for a very long time and has not been asked to move.

Doomguard Sentinel.name: Sentinel's Bulwark
Doomguard Sentinel.flavor_text: A tower shield with a brazier's soot worked into the face. Things that hit it come away burnt.

Doomguard Sentinel.name: Emberforged Gauntlets
Doomguard Sentinel.flavor_text: Mail gauntlets still ticking as they cool. You get used to it.

Doomguard Sentinel.name: Brand of the Doomguard
Doomguard Sentinel.flavor_text: A hot-iron ring that has never been quite cool. It does not burn the wearer. It insists.

Doomguard Sentinel.name: Grom's Rest Hand-Hook
Doomguard Sentinel.flavor_text: For holding a shield down while you deal with the man behind it.
Doomguard Sentinel.label: Fist (Agi)

Corrupted Ancient.name: Heartwood of the Fallen Grove
Corrupted Ancient.flavor_text: A staff of root and rot, with a heart-shaped knot at the head. It beats slowly.

Corrupted Ancient.name: Mantle of Twisted Boughs
Corrupted Ancient.flavor_text: Leather braided from living bark. It grows a little each time you look away.

Corrupted Ancient.name: Rotbark Cloak
Corrupted Ancient.flavor_text: A cloak of layered bark that sheds without ever getting thinner.

Corrupted Ancient.name: Wardroot Circlet
Corrupted Ancient.flavor_text: A woven crown of root. It was green once, and wants to be again.

Felguard Overseer.name: Overseer's Fel-Edge
Felguard Overseer.flavor_text: A long fel-iron blade, ridged for the cutting of chains and the lengthening of sentences.

Felguard Overseer.name: Legion Warplate
Felguard Overseer.flavor_text: Plate stamped with the Legion's mark. It fits like it knew you were coming.

Felguard Overseer.name: Sunderchain Girdle
Felguard Overseer.flavor_text: Heavy links, each stamped with a name. Somebody kept count.

Felguard Overseer.name: Overseer's Collar
Felguard Overseer.flavor_text: A fel-iron band, split at the clasp. Whoever it collared learned the clasp from the outside.

Lord Nightmare.name: Gaze of the Inner Sanctum
Lord Nightmare.flavor_text: A cowl with no face inside it, and no need for one.

Lord Nightmare.name: Staff of Eldritch Hours
Lord Nightmare.flavor_text: A staff of dark glass that tells the wrong time on purpose. Everything it counts down to is the same thing.

Lord Nightmare.name: Dreadweave Leggings
Lord Nightmare.flavor_text: Cloth that remembers a very long nightmare and offers to share.

Lord Nightmare.name: Horror-Touched Dirk
Lord Nightmare.flavor_text: A short blade of void-glass. It does not so much cut as subtract.
